lsystems.name: L-Systems: Rules Grow Structure
lsystems.truth: A sentence can become a forest. Grammar is generative.
lsystems.qfep_connection: Separate symbol rewriting from spatial interpretation, then investigate which forms, relations and exclusions each permits. Generation count is a construction parameter, not by itself an entropy measurement or a criticality threshold.
lsystems.description: Rewrite a sentence, follow its spatial interpretation, test the width of a passage and the conditions of growth. Change stored genes, compare a family built by face operations, then find paths in two repeated marks.

artifact_groups.rationale: Interactive pipeline: editor, tree output, visible string expansion, and visual anchor. Axiom rewriting producing organic structure.

One primary follows the actual saved-state trace and branch length ratio. Four retained studies explore timed generations, physical obstacle queries, tree drawing and cypress assembly; they are not a matched habitat experiment.
A controlled interpretation comparison opens the hall. Five authored works remain, with finite curve and grammar studies available for deeper development.
A full-size construction study distinguishes connected records from body-specific access. All nine authored works remain, including the original miniature.
Controlled resource and schedule comparison, with original five-strategy forest and independent coral retained.
Gene-to-body comparison and stable local specimen, preserving the earlier terrain and five secondary form studies.
Six retained bodies expose the mesh-grammar substrate behind form families; links Colour composition to later scored selection.
